Hidden draws, source/target copy keys and all texture input keys remain live; declaration-only shadow/mipmap/bloom buffers are not allocated. A GPU regression checks absence and output preservation across optimization toggles. Compile and the optimization toggle create target images through one newSceneTarget helper. A second GPU regression drops a copy the plan marks dead, turns optimization off without recompiling and checks that the copy gets a filled image and encodes no blit while optimization is on; it fails when copy destinations are left out of the referenced set or dead copies are made anyway. The local Metal harness takes its frame count from WE_TEST_METAL_FRAMES (2-3600, parsed after the no-project skip) so the probe's WE_TEST_FRAMES cannot shift its scene time, and prints MetalRender::RenderTargetBytesForTests next to the device-wide allocation.

auditRemediation.changes: Serialize shared-video preparation; conserve decoded audio across short reads, packet backpressure, drain and loops; apply video display matrices across Vulkan, Metal BGRA and direct NV12 paths; advance sprites by full elapsed time. Keep render graph terminal outputs and re-prepared target lifetimes consistent, refresh cached clear colors, propagate Metal archive overrides, balance pinned resources, isolate media caches, and make regression executables enforce assertions and classify GPU failures. Stabilize script program snapshots and hold audio-array bounds/views in native records; require Rust reflection metadata without legacy fallback. Implement text layout limits, local day time and random sound gaps. Correct BMP source-base decoding and stb allocation cleanup; fix miniaudio CoreAudio initialization, route replacement and pre-publication rollback. Enable JPEG NEON on arm64 after scalar-equivalent pixels and decoder-only timing checks. Empty artwork clears current/previous media textures and queued replay state. Original upstream notices and pinned revisions remain unchanged.
auditRemediation.reviewFollowup: PR #24 review: reject transformed BGRA sources when the conversion pipeline is unavailable; consistently skip unavailable video encoders and restore the test allocator through RAII.

puppetPoseBlendChanges.changes: Use effective non-additive layer weights for reference-pose deltas in translation, scale and rotation, matching the existing normalized base-pose budget. Prevent overlapping animations from stacking character-sheet assembly offsets. Additive weights, cached poses, passes and allocations are unchanged. Synthetic regressions cover normalized and partial weights, distinct motion, additive overlays, loop wrap, repeated samples and live blend/visibility changes.

presetAndSwitchLayerChanges.changes: Mount a scene's project folder under its package so a Workshop preset's own pictures and videos beside the base scene.pkg (files/...) resolve, with packaged files still winning; production and the probes share MountSceneSource. Draw a background-copying compose layer that another layer samples into its composite only, so masks that repaint it find their link texture instead of failing the native backend. Run property-script modules against their declared defaults and apply saved and user-bound scriptproperties before init, so top-level code sees the defaults as in Wallpaper Engine. Synthetic regressions cover each; no Workshop asset is committed.

sceneEngine.metalArchiveScratchChanges: 2026-10-13: MetalProgramCache::writeArchive serialises the pipeline archive to a scratch file in NSTemporaryDirectory() (owe-pipelines-<pid>-<serial>.metallib-archive, the serial touched only on the archive queue) and moves it to <store>.tmp<pid> before the existing replace-or-move over the store; a failed move logs and removes the scratch file. -[MTLBinaryArchive serializeToURL:error:] writes a scratch .metallib beside its destination and, when that folder is deleted during the write, double-frees in its error path (EXC_BAD_ACCESS in objc_retain, or a libmalloc abort, on macOS 27; reproduced standalone). The store's folder is the scene shader cache, which Clear shader cache, a cache rebuild or a removed wallpaper delete at any time, and the write runs two seconds after a wallpaper's last new pipeline. Found when unchanged_present_test removed its temporary folder right after a native case. Test-only MetalRender::WaitForPipelineArchiveWritesForTests (MetalProgramCache::finishArchiveWrites). Test: MetalSceneDraw.AStoreFolderDeletedWhileItsArchiveIsWrittenCostsOnlyThatWrite (eight stores written while their folders are deleted and made again in a loop; crashed 4 of 4 runs with serialisation beside the store, passes 4 of 4 with the change). No per-frame work: one extra rename per archive write.
sceneEngine.metalFrameStepChanges: 2026-10-13: MetalRender::drawFrame no longer calls WPShaderValueUpdater::FrameBegin. SceneWallpaper's draw handler already does once per frame for either backend; the second call stepped the parallax cursor's smoothing twice per frame, so the parallax on Native Metal chased the cursor twice as fast and a frame earlier than on Compatibility. Test loops that drive drawFrame directly (AdvanceSceneFrame, the local-project run, ParentedCardsStayJoinedWhileParallaxMovesAndReverses) take the host's step themselves. Test: ThePointerSmoothingStepsOnceForEachFrameTheHostDraws.
sceneEngine.metalCullModeChanges: 2026-10-13: Native Metal now culls like Compatibility. A pass into a depth-attached target takes its material's cull mode (ScenePassDescription::cull_mode from SceneMetalCullMode in MetalBlend.hpp, set per draw), with counter-clockwise front faces (kSceneFrontFaceCounterClockwise), matching CustomShaderPass's VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE behind its negative viewport; every other pass still culls nothing (kSceneCullMode). It used to cull nothing at all, which drew a planet ring model's unlit back faces over its front. Test: ADepthTestedDrawCullsTheSameFacesAsCompatibility draws each case through both renderers with DrawWithRenderer and requires identical pictures; it fails with culling off and with clockwise front faces.
sceneEngine.nativeMetalCompatibilityChanges: 2026-10-13: The native Metal backend now draws scenes it used to send to Compatibility as a whole. MetalCapability: scene lights are no longer refused (lighting is the author's shader reading g_LightsPosition and g_LightsColorPremultiplied, which WPShaderValueUpdater writes for either backend through reflection), and MetalGraphRejection no longer refuses a target read before it is written: the graph already flags it carriesPreviousFrame and MetalRender keeps one image per target name for the life of the graph; PlanCopyElision never aliases a destination read before its copy, StaticSubgraphCache calls the loop feedback, and the texture trade carries the copy's pixels. MetalRender: computeDemandReasons adds DynamicReason::Feedback when an allocated target carries the previous frame, so on-demand updating keeps the clock for it; a bound texture slot the graph left without a name (no producer, such as a layer texture whose layer draws no composite) marks the pass unproduced_input, which neither draws nor clears, as Compatibility's CustomShaderPass::textureDescriptorsReady does, instead of failing the compile (a name that does not load still fails it), with passClears() as the one answer. Tests: metal_backend_test ASceneWithLightsIsAccepted and ReadingATargetThatIsOnlyWrittenLaterIsAcceptedAsHistory; metal_scene_draw_smoke ASceneLightReachesTheAuthorsLightingUniforms, ALayerReadingThePreviousFrameSeesExactlyThePreviousFrame and AStepSamplingAnImageNothingProducesIsSkippedLikeOnCompatibility; unchanged_present_test AHistoryLoopKeepsTheClockRunningWithoutATimeUniform also runs the still card and the loop on native Metal.
sceneEngine.metalTargetSharingChanges: 2026-10-13: Native Metal render targets share images. MetalRender::Impl::shareTargetImages, run after the reuse table is compiled, gives targets of one shape whose spans of passes in the frame do not overlap one image (greedy by first use), as Compatibility's texture cache pools them; a target qualifies only if its first touch in a frame is a clear that runs (a clear step, or a draw opening with a clear that is not dropped for an unproduced input), no copy writes or reads it, and it is not carriesPreviousFrame, pinned, mip-mapped, depth-attached, an alias or the scene output. compileStaticCache records its pins and never pins an image another key shares. planPooledTrades turns the traded copies of one source into a pooled trade when every one of them is the only writer of its name, read only by later draws, not carried over and not pinned: the group owns as many images as copies are ever alive at once (simulated over the pass order) plus the source's; a copy takes a free image when it runs (traded: the copy's name takes the source's image and the source carries on in the free one, with the existing opening copy; not traded: a blit into the free one) and gives its image back at the pass after its last reader. beginPooledTrades resets the free sets and snapshots every pooled name each frame, abandonPooledTrades restores them, releasePooledTrades gives every pooled copy an image of its own again before an optimisation toggle reallocates, and a frame that ran a pooled copy is never treated as a repeat. WALLPAPER_MACHINE_METAL_TARGET_SHARING=0 (and the test-only MetalRender::SetTargetSharingForTests) turns both off. On a local scene with 42 traded screen copies the target memory went from 926 MB to 247 MB with no blit added. Test: TargetsThatAreNeverAliveTogetherShareImagesAndDrawTheSamePicture.
sceneEngine.rendererComparisonChanges: 2026-10-13: Test-only. metal_scene_draw_smoke gains WE_TEST_METAL_WARMUP_TICKS (runtime ticks before the graph is built, to put the local-project run on offscreen_scene_probe's clock) and the env-gated LocalProjectsDrawTheSamePictureOnBothRenderers (WE_TEST_COMPARE_PROJECTS, WE_TEST_COMPARE_SURFACE), which parses each local project twice and draws it through DrawWithRenderer on each renderer, printing the difference of the two posters. unchanged_present_test gains the env-gated LocalProjectEnergyIsMeasuredHeadlessly (WE_TEST_ENERGY_*): one local project on one renderer through the production SceneWallpaper at 60 FPS into an unattached layer, printing process CPU time and CPU energy, the GPU time of the process's own command buffers (a wrapper on the device's command-buffer commit counts MoltenVK's and the native backend's alike), all-coalition GPU energy, frames and footprint. Neither runs without its environment variable.

lockScreenExtension.idleResidencyChanges: Unlocked lock-screen surfaces retain an owned static poster and IOSurface snapshot, then release their renderer. Eligible locks reload behind the poster; failure preserves the poster and waits for a fresh unlock/lock cycle. Same-scene metadata updates reuse retained content without recreating an idle renderer. The poster CGImage reads its read-locked IOSurface through a no-copy Data provider instead of copying it into a second bitmap; releasing the image unlocks and releases the surface. Whether Core Animation keeps its own display copy is unmeasured. The snapshot and poster name the pixel format through kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA.
